requestedBy: User, 2026-10-03: keep adjusting the benchmark-side prompt only, and keep going until the adjustment brings a new gain. Nothing is landed in best-agent; this is a benchmark-side prompt experiment.
reason: Revisions 1 and 2 produced per-cell evidence that fixes what each layer should say. Rev-3 rewrites the A layer against that evidence: (a) the harness stops the primary Run at its reserved boundary (about four fifths of the declared budget) with no in-run warning, so late exploration is budget the attempt never gets to use; (b) rev-2 A's placeholder-first wording produced exactly the defect it was meant to prevent - the gcode cell shipped the literal placeholder '(analyzing text.gcode...)' as its final answer and never replaced it; (c) the gcode class spent its whole run on a hand-rolled renderer instead of the standard tool (its own evidence shows the model installing pillow/pytesseract only late and never producing a candidate string); (d) rev-1 A's db-wal pass came from fetching the task's original files over the network (the model downloaded the upstream main.db and main.db-wal.encrypted at t~420s), which is route variance, not a wording effect, so no A wording is credited with it. A-rev3 therefore asks for a real answer early, forbids a placeholder as the final state, points at the standard tool when a capability is missing, and states the four-fifths deadline. It keeps the same five cells: three targets plus the two guard cells that passed under the no-prefix control. Same composition, same mechanism (BEST_AGENT_INSTRUCTION_PREFIX=A, now rev-3 text), single delta.

verdicts.terminal-bench/db-wal-recovery: failed (no deliverable; destroyed its own encrypted WAL with the first sqlite3 probe)
verdicts.datacurve/expr-try-catch-errors: failed (77/79 f2p; failing: errtype type classification, errtype nil classification)

evidenceBasis.gcodeToText: Across five prior arms the deliverable was never produced: four arms never wrote /app/out.txt at all, and rev-2 A wrote '(analyzing text.gcode...)' at t=6.8s and submitted it 713s later without ever replacing it. The primary Run is cancelled at the reserved boundary (~719.8s of a 900s budget) and the adopted delivery Run then failed on a hung model call. Every arm burned the run on a self-built renderer and produced no candidate string.
evidenceBasis.exprTryCatchErrors: The self-check layer is what closed this cell: A arms failed 6 checks, B arms failed 1 (ErrtypeTypeError), unchanged between rev-1 and rev-2 wording. The survivor asks errtype() to classify a panic raised by code the model did not write (a runtime type mismatch from another implementation), and the closed family asks string(err) to render as the bare message - both are behaviors on values the new construct does not create itself.
evidenceBasis.dbWalRecovery: All four measured arms destroyed the encrypted WAL with their first sqlite3 probe (t=12s..27s). Rev-1 A passed only by downloading the task's original data and the real verifier file from the public upstream repository at t~420s; rev-2 A and rev-2 B never attempted the network and failed. The pass is therefore attributed to route variance (and to an internet-connected composition that allows retrieving upstream task files), not to the rev-1 A wording.
evidenceBasis.guards: largest-eigenval and sqlite-db-truncate passed under the no-prefix control in this composition; they are carried as regression detectors. Their control reading is single-attempt, so a guard failure is suggestive, not conclusive.

everythingElse: Unchanged: corpus pin (frontier-harness-eval/eval e837a70b), per-suite task sources, pier pin (0.3.1), candidate pin (cli 0.0.3-beta.41 da88e7a), provider (deepseek-v4-flash, dim-oauth, reasoning effort max), fh_agent_timeout_multiplier=1, budgets, execution profile, per-call ceiling, serial execution (fh_max_parallel=1). The only delta is the rev-3 A prefix text under BEST_AGENT_INSTRUCTION_PREFIX=A; it carries no task content and no verifier information, and it does not change the staged instruction.md hash that instructions.frozen verifies.

gainDefinition.primary: gcode-to-text reaches passed (the deliverable exists and its content is the correct flag) or expr-try-catch-errors reaches 79/79 f2p - neither has happened in any measured arm.
gainDefinition.partial: gcode-to-text leaves a real candidate string at its path instead of a placeholder, or the expr failing set shrinks below the previous best of one check.
gainDefinition.noRegression: Both guard cells still pass and every predeclared cell keeps a real verdict with the acceptance block intact.
gainDefinition.note: A guard failure or a cell regression is recorded as cost, not discounted; nothing here is evidence about other cells of the corpus.

constraints: Exactly one predeclared headless attempt per listed cell, nothing else.

Five cells: three targets (db-wal-recovery, gcode-to-text, expr-try-catch-errors) and two guards (largest-eigenval, sqlite-db-truncate) that passed under the no-prefix control; the guards exist to detect a prefix regression and are not targets.

readingBoundary: The comparison of interest is rev-3 A against the no-prefix control (five cells) and against the previous A arms on the delivery cells. A single attempt cannot separate wording from route variance for a cell that has varied before (db-wal-recovery, expr-try-catch-errors).
